character.name:
Don Paul R. Ramirez (The Town Elder)
Physical: An older man with a serious, weathered face and grey hair. He stands with a slight slouch from age but has a sharp, commanding voice.

Style: Wears a traditional Barong Tagalog made of high-tech fiber, showing his status in the semi-advanced town of Beringan.
